Domain: `domain:ui` · `bug` · `priority:p2`
Tier: **`opus`** = `TIER_DEFAULT`. ⛔ Not `sonnet` — site 2 needs its own measurement, not a copy of site 1's repair.
Clause-②: **assessed NO.** `primaryField` is **not declared on an object def by anything** — `@objectstack/spec`'s object schema is a `strictObject` that answers `unrecognized_keys: ['primaryField']`. Removing a consumer-side read of an undeclared key moves no declared surface and changes no accept set. ⚠️ It **does** change what a user sees (an H1, and which row a grid hides), which is a behaviour change and is why it is not a rider on #7287. If your own measurement contradicts the Clause-② call, ⛔ stop and report.

**Premise re-verified by this seat on `origin/main`, and it holds. Both sites are still live:**

```
packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1885   const primaryField: string | undefined = objSchema?.primaryField;
packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1915     (primaryField && data?.[primaryField]) ||
packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:162       objSchema?.primaryField,
```

⚠️ **Line drift from the card, minor but real:** the card says `:1886` / `:1916`; they are at **`:1885` / `:1915`** today. `:162` is exact.

**⭐ PR #7585 did land** — `b61d7d80a fix(plugin-detail): resolveTitleField delegates to the shared ADR-0079 ladder (#7585)` — so the card's "fixed by PR #7585" row is accurate and the two sites above are genuinely the remainder.

**⛔⛔ A trap I hit while verifying, handed to you so you do not repeat it.** A naive `grep -c primaryField` on `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` returns **8**, which looks like #7585 left reads behind. It did not. All eight are **documentation plus one deliberate type declaration**:

```
:54 :59 :65 :413 :417 :532 :534   ← comments explaining WHY the key is dead
:70   primaryField?: string;      ← on ObjectDefLike, kept ON PURPOSE
```

`:70` exists so that an external caller's object literal carrying the key still type-checks (`:65` states exactly this). ⛔ **Do not delete it as "the last read".** It is not a read; removing it would narrow a type for no benefit and break external callers. ⇒ the live read-site census is **two**, not three.

**Boundaries:**
- ⚠️ **The two sites are NOT one repair, and the card is emphatic about this.** ⛔ Do not apply the same patch twice.
  - **Site 1** (`containers.tsx`) is a **ranking bug in a title chain** — `primaryField` is ranked **above** the unified ADR-0079 resolver on the surface that renders the **actual H1** of a synthesized record page. ⇒ delegate to the shared resolver, the same move #7287 / PR #7585 made.
  - **Site 2** (`record-details.tsx`) is a **dedupe ladder with a different job** — it hides the H1 field from the body grid, keyed on the record value being non-empty, and `primaryField` is its *first* candidate. ⇒ it needs **its own before/after measurement**. ⚠️ Its docstring at `:151` couples it to `resolveTitleField` and that coupling went stale when #7585 landed — re-read it.
- ✅ The key is dead **structurally**, not merely by census: `primaryField` is declared on **`DetailViewSchema`** (`packages/types/src/views.ts:557` — verified) and nowhere on an object. objectstack#6326 removed this identical read from two lint rules for the same reason.
- ⭐ **The repo already wrote this down three times and left the reads standing.** `packages/components/CHANGELOG.md:5613`, `app-shell/CHANGELOG.md:11119`, `plugin-detail/CHANGELOG.md:2786` all say 「chain probed `objSchema.primaryField` (**not a spec property — always undefined**)」 — while the same files still carry the entry that **added** the behaviour. ⛔ You do not need to re-establish that the key is dead; you need to make the code agree with what the changelogs already say.
- ⛔ Do not edit `content/docs/releases/`. ⛔ Do not fold in #6557's `titleField` family — same shape, separate cards.

Serial constraints cleared: `packages/components/**` and `packages/plugin-detail/**` are named by no other slot in this wave (#7703 `types/complex.*` · #7727 `app-shell` · #7698 `plugin-charts` · #7816 `core`; PRs #8150/#8152/#8153 hold `fields`+`i18n`, `data-objectstack`+`app-shell`+`i18n`, and `plugin-kanban`). The queue arbitrates.

Landed as `daf9d576d` via PR #8179. Closing; `pm:dispatched` stripped and the assignee cleared in the same stroke.

**Verified by CONTENT** against a control proven before the merge — and the control had to be rebuilt, which is the part worth recording.

⛔ **A `primaryField` count would have reported this successful landing as FAILED.** Post-merge, `containers.tsx` carries **2** occurrences and `record-details.tsx` carries **6** — every one of them inside the new tombstone comments the PR adds to explain why the rung must never return. The naive marker moves in the wrong direction. The control is therefore built on **code lines**:

| marker | pre | post |
| :-- | --: | --: |
| `containers.tsx` · `const primaryField: string \| undefined =` | 1 | **0** |
| `containers.tsx` · `(primaryField && data?.[primaryField])` | 1 | **0** |
| `record-details.tsx` · `objSchema?.primaryField,` | 1 | **0** |
| **survival leg** — `DetailView.tsx` · `primaryField` | 3 | **3** |

The survival leg is not decoration. This card's whole distinction is between the read off an **object** def (removed) and the read off the **view** schema (legitimate, declared at `views.ts:557`). A control that only checked for absence could not tell a correct fix from one that deleted both.

CI at the ready-flip: 32 enumerated against `total_count: 32` — 28 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure, zero `in_progress`, `Lint` read explicitly (green 22:41:04Z), all four shards green. The single red was `Live E2E (informational)`, stood down structurally: its artifact upload reports **exactly 1 file**, so Playwright never ran and this diff cannot be implicated.

⭐ Two things this PR did that the card did not ask for, both right:

- It fixed the **ranking comment** at `containers.tsx:1871`, which described `objectSchema.primaryField` as an author override and went false the moment the rung was deleted — objectui#7070's "restated, not left to rot", applied without being told.
- It caught its own **vacuous pin**: the site-1 non-vacuity case originally typed the field as text `ref_no`, which ADR-0079's type-aware derivation would have selected on its own, so the test would have passed against the *unfixed* code. Retyping to `autonumber` made the deleted rung the only possible source of that heading.

Filed, not fixed here: **#8175** (the ladder hides the wrong row when the object declares a `nameField` the literal walk does not know), graded `p2`.
